items.docs: Lookup a reaction by its FID or cast.

params.name: target_fid
params.description: The FID of the cast's creator. Required to uniquely identify the cast that received the reactions. Must be used in conjunction with target_hash.

params.name: target_hash
params.description: The unique hash identifier of the cast that received the reactions. This is a 40-character hexadecimal string prefixed with '0x' that uniquely identifies the cast within the creator's posts. Must be used with target_fid.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of messages to return in a single response

params.name: reverse
params.description: Reverse the sort order, returning latest messages first

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The page token returned by the previous query, to fetch the next page. If this parameter is empty, fetch the first page
